title: CSIS Beyond Parallel — 'Pyongsan Uranium Concentrate Plant (Nam-chon Chemical Complex): Infrastructure Development and Status'
snippet: CSIS Beyond Parallel analysis of the Pyongsan Uranium Concentrate Plant (also known as Nam-chon Chemical Complex). Infrastructure development and current operational status assessment based on satellite imagery and open-source intelligence. Pyongsan is North Korea's primary facility for processing raw uranium ore into uranium concentrate (yellowcake), the essential feedstock for enrichment programs at Yongbyon and other sites.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 CSIS의 평산 우라늄 정광 공장 분석 보고서 없음. Daily NK 위성영상(src-003)과 독립적으로 동일 시설을 분석한 CSIS 보고서.
